description: This file defines internal utility classes for reference equality comparison within the Orleans project. It includes generic and non-generic implementations of IEqualityComparer that compare objects by reference, not by value.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer
classes.description: An internal class implementing IEqualityComparer<object> that compares objects by reference.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer<T>
classes.description: A generic internal class implementing IEqualityComparer<T> (where T is a class) that compares objects by reference.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines equality by reference comparison between two objects.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the object's reference, or 0 if null.
